item.title: FMD | 1.5 million vaccine doses arriving from Türkiye this weekend
item.description: The first shipment of foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) vaccine from Türkiye will arrive in South Africa this coming weekend.

item.title: Treasury unlocks R400 million to boost local FMD vaccine production
item.description: The Department of Agriculture will apply for funding via the Treasury’s Budget Facility for Infrastructure to expand and accelerate Onderstepoort Biological Products (OBP) production of its foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) vaccine, confirmed Dr Duncan Pieterse, director-general of finance.

item.title: Memorial speech for AFASA board member
item.description: Today I stand before you not only as a community member, not only as a farmer – but as a student. Because before Mr Mogajane was a leader in agriculture, before he was a pillar in the Africa Farmers Association of South Africa, he was a teacher. And I knew him first as Sir.

item.title: FMD | Vaccination update from the Eastern Cape
item.description: Hattingh Bornman, executive mayor of the Kouga Local Municipality in the Eastern Cape, says 1 212 cattle in Humansdorp have been vaccinated against foot-and-mouth disease to date. Vaccination of all cattle within a 10km radius of the area where an outbreak was reported will begin over the weekend.

item.title: Merino rams deliver quality and value at Hoogstede’s 2026 auction
item.description: BKB Cradock hosted a very successful ram auction on 22 January on behalf of Sakkie and Joana van Heerden of Hoogstede Merinos in the Tarkastad district.

item.title: WATCH | Dr Aamira Vally of the ARC gives tips on biosecurity
item.description: The virus that causes foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) can survive for up to six months in certain types of material, which must be taken into account by farmers when taking biosecurity measures. This was the advice of Dr Aamira Vally, a veterinarian with the Agricultural Research Council Irene Animal Production, at a cattle farmers’ day at Dr Pieter de Kock’s farm near Thabazimbi.

item.title: Land reform gets second chance: WIPHOLD’s plan to resurrect Zebediela Citrus Farm
item.description: After years of uncertainty and decline, the Limpopo government has secured what it believes is the right strategic partner to restore the historic Zebediela Citrus Estate to its former glory.

item.title: Treasury under pressure as Ramaphosa targets child malnutrition
item.description: President Cyril Ramaphosa has committed South Africa to ending child stunting by 2030, placing child nutrition firmly on the national agenda. The announcement, made during the State of the Nation Address (SONA) on 12 February, followed Cabinet’s approval of the National Strategy to Accelerate Action for Children (NSAAC), which outlines 10 priorities to improve the lives of children and teenagers.

item.title: FMD awareness | How foot-and-mouth disease spreads
item.description: Foot-and-mouth disease spreads quickly and easily – but understanding how the virus moves is the first step in protecting your livestock. Here’s what every farmer and livestock owner needs to know.
